description: This file defines the interface DocumentReadPlatformService, which provides methods for retrieving document data and files within the Fineract infrastructure.

classes.name: DocumentReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface providing methods to read and retrieve documents and associated file data from the platform.

methods.name: retrieveAllDocuments
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all documents for a given entity type and ID.

methods.name: retrieveFileData
methods.description: Retrieves the file data for a specific document associated with an entity.

methods.name: retrieveDocument
methods.description: Retrieves a specific document data object for the given entity and document IDs.
